title: Pan-Fried Saganaki with Honey-Walnut Dressing
summary: Golden pan-fried cheese is topped with a warm honey and walnut dressing for a sweet-savoury bite served straight from the pan.

ingredients.item: chopped parsley, plus leaves to garnish
slab of halloumi or kasseri, about 2.5 cm thick

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the chopped walnuts in the olive oil in a small saucepan on medium until golden and fragrant, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Add the honey and bubble until foamy, about 1 minute, then stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley and set aside.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the neutral oil in a cast-iron frying pan on high until smoking, about 3 minutes, patting the cheese dry first to limit spitting.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry the cheese slab until deep golden, about 2 minutes, then flip with a slotted spatula and fry the other side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Off the heat, spoon the warm walnut dressing over the cheese in the pan, garnish with parsley leaves and serve at once with a lemon wedge and bread.

tips: Use a slab about 2.5 cm thick; thinner pieces soften right through before the outside turns deep golden.
Fry on high heat just long enough to turn the outside deep golden while the centre stays soft.
Spoon the dressing over while both the cheese and dressing are still warm, then serve immediately.
safety: Pat the cheese dry before frying so it doesn't spit in the hot oil.
storage: Best eaten straight from the pan while hot; it does not keep or reheat well once the cheese has cooled. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
